import json, subprocess
req=json.loads(open('config/ci/required_status_checks.json').read())
required=set(req['required_contexts'])-set(req.get('ignored_contexts') or [])
print('REQUIRED_EFFECTIVE=')
for n in sorted(required):
    print(' ', n)
raw=subprocess.check_output(['gh','pr','view','6070','--json','statusCheckRollup,mergeable,mergeStateStatus,reviewDecision,isDraft,state'], text=True)
data=json.loads(raw)
by={}
for c in data['statusCheckRollup']:
    name=c['name']
    rec=(c.get('status'), c.get('conclusion'))
    by.setdefault(name, []).append(rec)
print('PR_STATE', data['state'], 'DRAFT', data['isDraft'], 'MERGEABLE', data['mergeable'], 'MERGE_STATE', data['mergeStateStatus'], 'REVIEW', data['reviewDecision'])
missing=[]
bad=[]
for n in sorted(required):
    recs=by.get(n)
    if not recs:
        missing.append(n)
        print('MISSING_REQUIRED', n)
        continue
    # latest-ish: prefer COMPLETED SUCCESS
    ok=any(s=='COMPLETED' and conc=='SUCCESS' for s,conc in recs)
    if not ok:
        bad.append((n, recs))
        print('REQUIRED_NOT_GREEN', n, recs)
    else:
        print('REQUIRED_PASS', n)
print('MISSING_COUNT', len(missing))
print('BAD_COUNT', len(bad))
# non-required not SUCCESS/SKIPPED
pending=[]
fail=[]
for name, recs in sorted(by.items()):
    for s,conc in recs:
        if s != 'COMPLETED':
            pending.append((name,s,conc))
        elif conc not in ('SUCCESS','SKIPPED',''):
            fail.append((name,s,conc))
print('NONCOMPLETED', pending)
print('FAILED_OR_OTHER', fail)
